title: Setting up dashboards to monitor performance metrics with CloudWatch [Hands-On]

cues.en: Welcome back to the Console and the second tool or solution to monitor the performance of your machinery mode with dashboards that you can set up yourself
cues.zh: 歡迎回到主控台。第二個可讓你自行設定儀表板，監控機器學習模型效能的工具或方案，

cues.en: is CloudWatch Dashboards.
cues.zh: 就是 CloudWatch Dashboards。

cues.en: And then there we go. You go here to Dashboards.
cues.zh: 到這裡的 Dashboards。

cues.en: Be careful not to click this one CloudWatch Dashboard.
cues.zh: 小心別按到這個 CloudWatch Dashboard。

cues.en: That's actually a systems manager feature.
cues.zh: 那其實是 Systems Manager 的功能。

cues.en: No, the one we're interested in is, of course, the CloudWatch feature.
cues.zh: 我們要的是 CloudWatch 的功能。

cues.en: Okay, so Dashboards and that's, indeed, your second option of setting up dashboards in order to monitor the performance of your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 選 Dashboards。這就是設定儀表板、監控機器學習模型效能的第二個選項。

cues.en: Okay and same, here the console is a bit more simple.
cues.zh: 這裡的主控台比較簡單。

cues.en: You create your dashboard here.
cues.zh: 在這裡建立儀表板。

cues.en: You give it a name by, for example, calling it Machine Learning.
cues.zh: 為它命名，例如 Machine Learning。

cues.en: All right Machine Learning, Create Dashboard and then you can add different metrics.
cues.zh: 好，Machine Learning，按 Create dashboard，然後就能加入不同指標。

cues.en: There we go, Metrics, in your dashboard to monitor the performance of your models, okay.
cues.zh: 也就是在儀表板加入 Metrics，監控模型效能。

cues.en: So first, you can choose the Data Type; Metrics, Logs or Alarms.
cues.zh: 先選資料類型：Metrics、Logs 或 Alarms。

cues.en: We're gonna click Metrics.
cues.zh: 我們選 Metrics。

cues.en: Then you choose the Widget type between Line to compare metrics over time or Data Table to compare metrics values over time in a table.
cues.zh: 接著選小工具類型。Line 可比較指標隨時間的變化，Data table 則以表格比較不同時間的指標值。

cues.en: Number to instantly see the latest value for a metric.
cues.zh: Number 可立即顯示某個指標的最新值。

cues.en: Gouge to see the latest value of a metric within a range.
cues.zh: Gauge 可在一個範圍內顯示指標的最新值。

cues.en: Stacked area, Bar, Pie, Explorer, okay.
cues.zh: 還有 Stacked area、Bar、Pie、Explorer。

cues.en: So let's click Line, for example, then let's click Next.
cues.zh: 例如選 Line，再按 Next。

cues.en: And there we go, that's how you connect to SageMaker, for example, here with the SageMaker endpoints or SageMaker inference components.
cues.zh: 這樣就能連接 SageMaker，例如這裡的 SageMaker endpoints 或 SageMaker inference components。

cues.en: So let's choose SageMaker endpoints, as we are now familiar with them.
cues.zh: 我們已經熟悉 SageMaker 端點，所以選它。

cues.en: And then here you can choose some metrics related to the EndpointName and VariantName.
cues.zh: 這裡可以選擇與 EndpointName 和 VariantName 有關的指標。

cues.en: So let's click this and what will we get?
cues.zh: 點開看看有什麼。

cues.en: Yes, ML-Model-Endpoint for the MemoryUtilization.
cues.zh: 有 ML-Model-Endpoint 的 MemoryUtilization。

cues.en: ML-Model-Endpoint for the CPUUtilization.
cues.zh: 還有 ML-Model-Endpoint 的 CPUUtilization。

cues.en: So here, you see that it's pretty similar to what we saw in SageMaker Model Monitor, except that this time you have much more flexibility in how you're gonna use the metrics
cues.zh: 你會看到，這和剛才在 SageMaker Model Monitor 看到的相當類似，但這次使用指標的方式更有彈性，

cues.en: and you're gonna set all these metrics up yourself in your own dashboard.
cues.zh: 而且所有指標都由你自行設定到自己的儀表板。

cues.en: So that's really the difference and that's why I'm telling you that if you see dashboard in the question at the exam, well think rather CloudWatch Dashboard, instead of SageMaker Model Monitor.
cues.zh: 這就是差別。所以考題若出現儀表板，要優先想到 CloudWatch Dashboard，而非 SageMaker Model Monitor。

cues.en: But there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: ML-Model-Endpoint same for DiskUtilization and MemoryReservation, CPUUtilization.
cues.zh: ML-Model-Endpoint 也有 DiskUtilization、MemoryReservation、CPUUtilization。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: You have all these metrics that you can set up in your own dashboard, okay.
cues.zh: 這些指標都可以放入自己的儀表板。

cues.en: So let's take, for example, the first one and the second one; MemoryUtilization, CPUUtilization.
cues.zh: 例如選第一個和第二個：MemoryUtilization、CPUUtilization。

cues.en: Just like in SageMaker Monitor, you select these two and then you create your widget.
cues.zh: 和 SageMaker Monitor 一樣，選取這兩項，再建立小工具。

cues.en: And there you go, you have your widget and you can have some other widgets here in your own machine learning dashboard.
cues.zh: 這樣就有一個小工具，也可以在自己的機器學習儀表板加入其他小工具。

cues.en: All right, so there you go and then you click Save to save the dashboard.
cues.zh: 接著按 Save 儲存儀表板。

cues.en: And if you wanna delete it, you click Actions here and you click Delete Dashboard.
cues.zh: 若要刪除，按這裡的 Actions，再按 Delete dashboard。

cues.en: All right, once again, that's largely enough for you to crack and smash any performance monitoring questions at the exam, whether it is oriented towards SageMaker Model Monitor
cues.zh: 再強調一次，這些內容已足以幫你順利解答考試中的效能監控問題，不論題目著重 SageMaker Model Monitor，

cues.en: or QuickSight plus CloudWatch Dashboard.
cues.zh: 還是 QuickSight 與 CloudWatch Dashboard。

cues.en: So now I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待在下一堂實作教學再見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
